svg.aria-label: ACE architecture: any phone in, checked and cited answers out. Six entry points (USSD, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, web and API, MCP) feed one pseudonymous identity, then the engine runs the safety rail, Scam Shield, checked context and a cited answer, drawing on sourced context packs for 34 countries in eight languages and, optionally, any model kept to the facts.
